mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCalls, SUM(CASE WHEN answered_at IS NOT NULL OR (talk_duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND talk_duration_ms > 0) OR (audio_duration_sec IS NOT NULL AND audio_duration_sec > 0) OR UPPER(IFNULL(status, '')) IN ('ANSWERED', 'COMPLETED') OR UPPER(IFNULL(result, '')) = 'ANSWER' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answeredCalls, IFNULL(SUM(IFNULL(talk_duration_ms, 0)), 0) AS totalTalkMs, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(IFNULL(direction, '')) = 'INBOUND' THEN IFNULL(talk_duration_ms, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS inboundTalkMs, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(IFNULL(direction, '')) = 'OUTBOUND' THEN IFNULL(talk_duration_ms, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS outboundTalkMs FROM fcc_call_session WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND started_at >= #{startTime}
